description: A stunning light-filled primary bedroom under a dramatic vaulted cathedral ceiling of white-painted shiplap planking with exposed white-painted structural ridge beams. The room is saturated in soft creamy natural light streaming through a pair of tall French doors with black hardware and multi-pane glazing centered on the far wall, framed by floor-to-ceiling linen drapery panels in the palest ivory-white. Beyond the French doors, a lush green meadow and mature trees are visible. The wall surfaces are smooth warm off-white plaster. A large bed with a woven rattan or cane-panel headboard in warm honey wood tones is dressed in a generous layering of cream linen, caramel boucle pillows, and a soft sand-toned throw blanket at the foot. A low-pile natural fiber area rug in warm ivory grounds the seating zone. On the right side of the frame, a low white painted six-drawer dresser with brushed nickel hardware sits against the wall, topped with a round ceramic vase holding a loose arrangement of dried natural stems. A small upholstered armchair in cream fabric with an exposed light wood frame and an accent pillow sits adjacent to the dresser. A large potted olive tree in a tall white ceramic pot is positioned in the left corner, its silvery-green branches arching toward the ridge of the ceiling. A ribbed or fluted oblate sphere-form fabric ceiling element hangs from the ridge at center, emitting warm diffused glow downward through the room. Camera at standing eye-level, wide lens, three-quarter view of the bedroom with the French doors and ceiling in frame.
